title: Lead Technical Program Manager
description:
**Opportunity Overview:**



We're seeking a strategic and execution\-focused Technical Program Manager to drive large, cross\-functional initiatives from concept through launch. In this role, you will lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex, multi\-team programs—such as platform migrations, architectural modernization, reliability improvements, and major product launches—while defining clear milestones, success metrics, and sequencing plans. You'll partner deeply with Engineering to proactively manage dependencies, mitigate risk, and ensure technical and business alignment. This role also strengthens our execution systems by improving program transparency, standardizing launch rigor, and translating technical complexity into clear executive\-level insights.


**What you'll do:**


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of multi\-team initiatives (e.g., platform migrations, architectural modernization, reliability improvements, major product launches)
* Define milestones, critical paths, and measurable success criteria
* Break ambiguous initiatives into executable phases with clear sequencing
* Identify and manage cross\-team technical dependencies
* Proactively surface risks and tradeoffs with mitigation plans
* Run structured risk reviews and escalation processes when needed
* Participate in technical design discussions to understand architecture and constraints
* Ensure design reviews, capacity planning, and rollout strategies happen early
* Collaborate with EMs and engineers leaders to align on realistic timelines
* Establish program tracking mechanisms that create transparency without bureaucracy
* Standardize launch readiness, milestone reviews, and postmortem follow\-ups
* Identify systemic delivery bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement
* Provide concise executive updates with clear status, risks, and asks
* Maintain decision logs and documentation for key initiatives
* Translate technical complexity into business impact


**What you'll need:**


**Must\-haves**


* 6\+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or related roles in high\-growth technology companies
* 6\+ years of experience hands on experience as a software engineer
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum/SAFe or other delivery frameworks (with pragmatic application)
* Demonstrated experience leading multi\-team, multi\-quarter technical initiatives
* Strong technical fluency (experience working closely with backend, infrastructure, data, or platform engineering teams)
* Ability to understand system architecture, dependencies, and engineering tradeoffs
* Proven track record of driving programs to completion in ambiguous environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including influencing senior engineering leaders
* Excellent english written and verbal communication skills
* Experience implementing program management frameworks, milestone tracking, and risk management systems


**Nice\-to\-haves**


* Experience in platform engineering, infrastructure modernization, large\-scale migrations, GenAI Integrations, inference infrastructure, data pipelines, model deployment platforms
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Experience in scaling startups
* Experience improving delivery predictability metrics (e.g., on\-time delivery, scope control, forecast accuracy)
* Experience supporting compliance, security, or reliability initiatives
* MBA or advanced technical degree


**ISMS roles and responsibilities**


* Good knowledge of Information practices.
* Assist the manager in all the information security activities implementation and maintenance process.
* Ensuring the team and imparted with Competence related to Information security
* Responsible for implementation of security policies and procedures and report any issues to the Information Security Manager.


**Ability to commute/relocate:**


* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)


**Interview Process\*:**



* Connect with Talent Acquisition


* Meet with the Hiring Manager


* Behavioral Interview(s)


* Case Study


* Interview with Senior Leadership



* Subject to change


**About Cohere Health:**



Cohere Health's clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI\-powered solutions connect health plans' strategic goals and providers' needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer\-provider decision\-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction.



With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we expanded our AI\-native platform with a comprehensive Payment Integrity Suite that spans data mining, clinical and coding validation, authorization and claims reconciliation, and end\-to\-end payment integrity services across pre\- and post\-pay workflows. By connecting clinical and payment insights, our transparent, AI\-powered solutions help health plans proactively improve payment accuracy, reduce waste and vendor dependency, strengthen provider relationships, and build smarter, more efficient payment integrity programs.



Cohere Health's innovations continue to receive industry\-wide recognition. We've been recognized on TIME's World Top HealthTech Companies 2025 list, the 2025 Inc. 5000 list, in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022\-2025\), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 \& 2024\.


**We can't wait to learn more about you and meet you at Cohere Health!**


**Equal Opportunity Statement:**



Cohere Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all. To us, it's personal.

title: Senior Program Manager, Global Quality Ops - Platform Integrity
description:
**About the Role**  

  

The PI Quality Operations team will own the end\-to\-end quality operating rhythm across the PI BPO footprint within the GSO network, including quality audits, Audit\-the\-Auditor (ATA), calibrations, quality score governance, insight generation, and quality improvement interventions . The team's mandate is to ensure Quality scores are accurate, consistent, trusted, and actionable , while identifying the key drivers of performance and translating quality data into clear actions that improve agent performance and customer outcomes.
  

  

The Quality Operations Manager \- Platform Integrity (PI) will lead this team of approximately 5\-7 Quality S\-ladder team members and be accountable for the overall health and performance of PI Quality Operations. The manager will partner closely with BPO Operations, Vendor Management, Training, Program, Policy, Product, Analytics, and Global Quality stakeholders to strengthen quality governance, address systemic performance gaps, and ensure quality insights lead to measurable improvements in frontline execution.
  

  

**What You'll Do*** Own PI Quality performance across the BPO network , driving sustained improvement in Quality scores and building clear recovery plans for underperforming sites, queues, or agent populations.
* Ensure Quality scores are accurate, consistent, and trusted by owning audit governance, sampling effectiveness, evaluator accuracy, score integrity, and scoring consistency across the network.
* Lead audit, Audit\-the\-Auditor (ATA), and calibration programs to improve evaluator accuracy, reduce scoring variance, and strengthen alignment across internal and BPO Quality teams.
* Turn Quality data into actionable insights by identifying key defect drivers, conducting root\-cause analysis, and translating findings into targeted actions that improve agent performance.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Operations, Training, Policy, Program, Product, and Analytics to address systemic Quality issues and improve processes, tooling, scorecards, and frontline execution.
* Drive continuous improvement and scalability by simplifying, standardizing, and improving Quality operating mechanisms across sites, markets, languages, and lines of business.

**Basic Qualifications*** 6\+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Operations within BPO, contact center, customer support, trust \& safety, risk operations, or a comparable high\-volume service environment.
* Experience managing Quality professionals and demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and performance\-manage a team.
* Demonstrated experience improving Quality scores through structured root\-cause analysis and operational interventions rather than solely monitoring or reporting performance.
* Strong understanding of Quality measurement integrity , including scoring consistency, inter\-rater reliability, evaluator variance, sampling methodology, and calibration.
* Proven ability to analyze Quality data, identify performance drivers, generate actionable insights, and translate findings into improvement plans.
* Strong understanding of BPO operating environments, including vendor governance, performance management, SLAs/KPIs, corrective action planning, and multi\-site operations.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and demonstrated ability to influence teams outside of direct reporting lines.
* Experience working with Quality monitoring platforms, CRM/customer\-service systems, and business intelligence or reporting tools such as NICE, Observe.AI, Tableau, Looker, Data Studio, or comparable platforms .

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience building or redesigning Quality scorecards, sampling strategies, calibration frameworks, or Quality governance models.
* Experience using statistical or analytical techniques to evaluate scoring reliability, performance variation, and Quality trends..
* Lean, Six Sigma, COPC, or other Quality/process\-improvement certification is advantageous.
* Multilingual experience or experience supporting multilingual Quality operations is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**  

  

Success in this role means:
* PI Quality scores show sustained and measurable improvement.
* Quality scores are **trusted by Operations and BPO partners** as an accurate representation of frontline performance.
* Audit and ATA accuracy remain consistently high across the network.
* Evaluator variance decreases, and calibration alignment improves.
* Quality insights consistently identify the highest\-impact performance opportunities and lead to concrete operational action.
Quality interventions demonstrate measurable improvement in agent behavior and performance.  
* 

  

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Program Manager II, ECR, NOC ECR
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Executive Customer Relations Team operates within Amazon India's Network Operations Center (NOC), serving as the critical bridge between senior leadership escalations and systemic customer experience improvement. The team manages direct escalations from L10\+ leaders requiring comprehensive investigation, root cause analysis, executive\-level communications, and cross\-functional action item ownership. This team aims to transform every executive escalation into a systemic improvement opportunity by conducting rigorous root cause analysis, driving timely CAPA closures, and identifying thematic defect patterns that convert to programmatic interventions — ultimately reducing repeat defects and elevating the end\-to\-end customer experience across Amazon India's operations.  

  

The individual in this role will own defined workstreams within the ECR program charter, collaborating with program, product, tech, BI, and Science partners to execute, validate, and deploy customer experience capabilities. This role will coordinate with teams across IN Ops to support the launch and adoption of bespoke product solutions within their assigned scope. The ideal candidate will obsess over customers and have a demonstrated ability to deliver results while managing moderate complexity and ambiguity. Successful candidates will have experience in Program Management, comfort working with cross\-organizational stakeholders, and the ability to manage competing priorities with appropriate escalation.  

  

As a Program Manager, you will own and deliver well\-defined workstreams and projects by coordinating with cross\-disciplinary teams to execute customer\-facing initiatives. You thrive by understanding the broader vision, aligning your workstream to it, and driving execution — proactively identifying risks, flagging escalations, making day\-to\-day trade\-offs, and balancing business needs against technical constraints. You must decompose assigned projects into clear deliverables with functional specifications and execute them on time with minimal oversight. Good judgment, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence peers and partner teams are essential. Working knowledge of data analysis and SQL is expected. The role will also be expected to support Generative AI adoption within ECR — including implementing automated case summarization, contributing to pattern recognition for thematic defects, and supporting predictive escalation routing — executing on identified Gen AI opportunities that augment human judgment, reduce manual effort, and accelerate resolution timelines.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

They will be responsible for working with all Miles (LM, MM, FC), Multiple Program teams (ACES, DSP, IHS, FC), and Multiple Product teams (ROW APEX, DEX, RCX) to identify pain points and scope out large high\-impact solutions to improve Delivery Experience.  

  

They will be responsible for driving VP inquiries to closure within SLA with clear articulation of issue and recommended initiatives to arrest the root cause of the defect. They will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure Action Item progress and own writing reports that detail progress to leadership on a frequent basis.  

  

They will liaise across functions to drive their projects, help clear issues and bottlenecks, and work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed.  

  

They will implement and iterate on Generative AI solutions (e.g., automated case summarization bots, AI\-assisted root cause analysis, intelligent response suggestion engines) to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and accelerate VP inquiry resolution timelines — executing on use cases identified and scoped by leadership

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Project Manager – Residential High-Rise Construction
description:
**Location:** Kokapet, Hyderabad  
**Project Type:** Large\-scale Premium Residential Development  
**Project Scale:** 8\.5\-acre development \| 9 Towers \| G\+9 Floors \| 750\+ Residential Units

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced **Project Manager** to lead the planning, execution, coordination and successful delivery of a large\-scale premium residential development in Kokapet, Hyderabad.

The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that construction activities are executed safely, efficiently, within approved timelines and to the required quality standards, while effectively coordinating with all project stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

* Take overall responsibility for the day\-to\-day execution and progress of the project.
* Develop and monitor project schedules, milestones and construction targets.
* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, contractors, vendors and site teams.
* Monitor construction activities across multiple residential towers and associated development works.
* Ensure execution is in accordance with approved drawings, specifications and project requirements.
* Track progress against planned schedules and identify potential delays or bottlenecks.
* Conduct regular site inspections and ensure effective coordination between various construction activities.
* Monitor workmanship and maintain required quality standards.
* Coordinate procurement and ensure timely availability of materials and resources.
* Review contractor performance, productivity and manpower deployment.
* Maintain project documentation, progress reports, measurements and relevant records.
* Identify construction risks and implement timely corrective measures.
* Ensure compliance with applicable safety practices and site procedures.
* Coordinate execution of common areas, landscaping, approach roads, recreational facilities and clubhouse\-related works.
* Work closely with management to provide regular updates on cost, schedule, quality and overall project progress.

Candidate Profile

**Education:** B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification.

**Experience:** Preferably **8–12\+ years** of relevant experience in residential high\-rise construction/project management, with experience handling large\-scale developments.

Desired Skills

* Strong knowledge of residential construction processes
* Excellent project planning and scheduling abilities
* Contractor and consultant management
* Strong understanding of construction quality and safety
* Cost and resource management
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Strong communication and leadership skills
* Ability to manage multiple activities and teams simultaneously
* Proficiency in project planning and reporting tools such as **MS Project, Primavera or equivalent**

Key Performance Expectations

The Project Manager will be expected to deliver the project with a strong focus on:

**TIME • QUALITY • COST • SAFETY • COORDINATION • CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE**

This role requires strong multidisciplinary coordination across residential towers, landscaped areas, sports and recreational facilities, common areas and clubhouse infrastructure.

Pay: ₹23,376\.05 \- ₹91,180\.33 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Specialist - Project Management - Regional Managing Principal - Hyderabad
description:

* Develop presentations, points of view, and industry and competitor benchmarking reports to support leadership discussions
* Track and support multiple regional projects, including prioritization, issue follow\-up, and execution coordination
* Support the development of business cases for new initiatives across the region
* Prepare management reports with analysis, insights, and metrics for review by senior stakeholders
* Coordinate with stakeholders across businesses and enabling areas to support strategic priorities, leadership programs, and project execution

Office of the Regional Managing Principal (ORMP) serves as the central point of the US firm’s organization in India. Required:


* 3\-5 years of professional experience in project management, business management, operations, finance, or a similar field

* Experience using Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel for analysis, reporting, and presentation development
